items.title: Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 1997
items.q: VSOP put out an album of Bob Cooper and I. It was a live broadcast we did for KLON, a jazz station in Long Beach.

ctx.x: That’s some good stuff right there.

You know what I’m glad you like it because I hadn’t heard that in a long time and I forgot about that tune. That was “Mambo Blues” huh? Because VSOP put out an album of Bob Cooper and I. It was a live broadcast we did for KLON, a jazz station in Long Beach. And it was Bob Cooper’s last music before he died, about a couple of months. And VSOP put it out on a CD. I wish I had that with me. I’ll have to send you that.
